Nora: Quick sync re: CareBridge PoC. Monica says peak shape is bursty: baseline ~300 RPS, short spikes up to 1k RPS for 5-15min/day. Avg seq ~100, long-context model (3k). Need recommended reserved commit + burst escrow + preheat story for execs.
Ajay: Got it. Quick clarifying q: are embeddings on same endpoint?
Monica: Embeds are routed separately to smaller instances; gen is the main driver. Tokens/day estimate ~400M. 95p latency target for gen <350ms.
Claire: Ballpark math: on a 3k-context model @100 tokens, a well-optimized A100-equivalent node (quantized + KV hits) can sustain ~250-400 RPS depending on batching. For 1k spike, aim for reserved baseline 4 GPUs + 2 hot standbys = 6 reserved, with burst escrow to cover spike minutes and preheat to reduce cold-start tail.
Ajay: Proposed minimal config: reserved_gpus=6, burst_escrow_tokens=800M, autoscale_min=4, autoscale_target_util=65, preheat=20m before expected windows. Add AZ spread min 2 AZs and a quantized fallback variant for spot/backfill.
Nora: How did you compute 800M burst escrow? Need to show the formula for finance.
Ajay: Example calc: assume daily spikes totalling 20min at avg 1k RPS -> extra tokens = 1000*100*1200s = 120M tokens/day -> ~3.6B/month. But reserved GPUs handle baseline throughput; escrow size trimmed to cover delta after reserved capacity. I will produce a table showing worst/expected cases and GPU-hour estimates for SOW.
Claire: Ops note: prefill KV with last 10-30m of traffic during preheat, and run a short synthetic rehearsal to warm device kernels. Provide `kv-warm --window 900 --parallel 6` job. Also include an eviction-hedge: if spot eviction occurs, route new requests to fallback model and drain queues.
Monica: Security/legal: CareBridge requires KMS keys, VPC peering for private deploys, and audit logs for 2 years. They also want a brief note on data residency (EU).
Nora: We'll include Private deployment options in SOW appendix and mark region constraint EU-west.
Ajay: Smoke test plan for PoC execs: three runs (baseline 300 RPS 30m, burst 1k RPS for 15m, soak 200 RPS 3h). Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, KV hit rate, queue depth and token consumption. Example command: `redwood-load --target https://staging.redwood/carebridge --rps 1000 --duration 900 --seq 100 --track p95,p99,gpu_util,kv_hit,queue`
infra-bot: Preheat job scheduled: staging/kv-warm v1.4 by ajay. ETA 12m.
Nora: Action items: Ajay -> sizing table + cost delta reserved vs burst + GPU-hour numbers by EOD. Claire -> ops runbook snippets and preheat job today. Monica -> upload peak sample CSV and security questionnaire. I'll draft SOW appendix with region & KMS notes.
Monica: Uploading CSV now. One ask: can we include a fallback quality note comparing standard vs quantized 8-bit on a few sample prompts?
Claire: Yes, will run 50 eval prompts and attach delta summary.
Nora: Good. Let's aim to present the one-pager and smoke test results to CareBridge next week.
Ajay: ack, starting math now.
Nora: thanks team :thumbsup:
